## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] If I touched `recipes/`, I regenerated `templates/generic/` and `build-templates.ps1 -Check` is clean
- [ ] If I added a recipe, it is in `src/recipes.json` and in the README recipe table
- [ ] Generated files stay language-agnostic (no Node/Python/Go assumptions)
- [ ] No two recipes provide the same path
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (README / CONTRIBUTING / docs/)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
